|-|Tips=
{{Achievement|Imitations|jpg|On the [[Stealing Xmas]] job, find and take both Paycheck masks. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Paycheck Dallas]]" and "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Paycheck Chains]]" masks.}}
The masks have 6 known locations throughout the mall, though the masks do not share spawn locations, with each having 3 unique spawns. For their exact locations, consult [http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814648556 this guide].

{{Achievement|The Grinch|jpg|On the [[Stealing Xmas]] job, secure all additional loot on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
There are exactly 9 loot bags to steal on all difficulties. The shoe store and tech store both have a back room with loot inside, with the shoe store having a few money bundles and a money bag, and the tech store having several money bundles and phones and two money bags, one of which in a safe that has to be drilled/lockpicked/blown open.

Note that the heist does not need to be completed after securing all loot, as the achievement is rewarded automatically.
|-|Trivia=
*The teasers may be a reference to the ''{{w|Keep Calm and Carry On}}'' motivational posters.
*'''The Grinch''' is an obvious reference to ''{{w|How the Grinch Stole Christmas!}}''.
